text: Niece has chickenpox, 5 yrs old. Spots everywhere and she's scratching like mad which is why nobody's sleeping. Temp just now 39.7 which seemed high to me. Also streaming nose and sneezing all evening. Pressed a glass on the spots and they all go pale so I don't think it's anything worse than the pox. Breathing's fine. Otherwise she's her usual self, just itchy and grumpy. Anything I can do for the itching and the temperature or do I just ride it out, I'm shattered
